desc: Characterize degree-sequence collisions using accumulated Boolean relations on \(\{0,1\}\).
Design the constant-state DP counting distinct degree sequences with cyclic wraparound.
Correct the \(s_i=1\), degree-2 local relation mask to 13.
Validate the corrected implementation against the provided samples and exhaustive small-case reasoning.
Confirm hub indegree is uniquely determined by the ordinary degree sequence and finalize the \(O(N)\)-time implementation.
